heading: What Homeowners Wrote On Google
lead: Copied word for word from our Google Business Profile. Open the profile to read every review, including the ones we would rather you did not.

items.name: Ziv R.
items.text: I highly recommend Northmark! They did an absolutely amazing and professional job on the tuckpointing, using high-quality materials. Thanks to their excellent work, I can continue safely using my chimney, and they prevented further damage to the concrete. Their pricing was also the best I found on the market. Great quality, professionalism, and value for money. I couldn’t be happier with the results! Highly recommended!

items.name: C. C.
items.text: Booked my appointment online for a chimney sweep. Ben was very quick on responding and confirming my time slot. Once Ben inspected my flue, he noticed an issue that I was not aware off and recommended we do not sweep until resolved. My previous chimney sweep company that I used did not even mention that issue to me. I thank Ben for his honesty and would definitely recommend this company.

items.name: Louise V.
items.text: We discussed my concerns... (The damper is bent and there's a noticable smell of smoke when the fire dies down). Pictures were taken and a solution was discussed and agreed upon. Very friendly and knowledgeable. Would absolutely recommend.

items.name: Jason H.
items.text: Great job and professional service. Took the time to explain potential future issues with my fireplace to keep it safe.

items.name: Nissan
items.text: I had them this week to repair my chimney's masonry clean work, great prices, great communication would recommend to anyone

items.name: Joanna S.
items.text: Professional and friendly service. We are very happy with the work done. Would recommend to anyone interested in chimney repair.

items.name: R. H.
items.text: Big difference between before and after. Great service and awesome finished product!

items.name: Or H.
items.text: Special thanks to Liel for the wonderful assistance, professionalism, and integrity. Highly recommended without a doubt, and that says a lot coming from someone who rarely gives recommendations!

items.name: Shahar A.
items.text: Ben helped me cleaning my chimney - perfect service, great guy would recommend to anyone

items.name: Lynda D.
items.text: Thank you for the service. Punctual, knowledgeable. Happy to recommend.

items.name: Paul B.
items.text: Very quick and fair, excellent work done
